name: dropdown-menu
title: DropdownMenu
description: A menu of actions opened from a button, on Base UI's Menu: items with shortcuts and a danger tone, checkbox and radio items, groups with labels, separators and submenus, on color.bg.overlay at z.popover.
usage: Use DropdownMenu for a list of actions or options behind one button: tab actions under a "more" IconButton, copy formats, view options. Compose it as DropdownMenu > DropdownMenuTrigger (render a Button or IconButton) + DropdownMenuContent > DropdownMenuItem (onClick; danger for a destructive one; DropdownMenuShortcut at the end), DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (checked, onCheckedChange), DropdownMenuRadioGroup (value, onValueChange) with DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuGroup with DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, and DropdownMenuSub > DropdownMenuSubTrigger + DropdownMenuSubContent for a submenu. For a menu on right-click use ContextMenu; for an app's menu row, Menubar; for a primary action with variants, SplitButton; for picking a form value, Select; for a searchable list of every command, CommandPalette.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger, an item, Escape or an outside press opens or closes it.

props.name: modal
props.description: As Base UI: the page ignores the pointer and does not scroll while the menu is open.

props.name: side
props.description: DropdownMenuContent: the side of the trigger; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: align
props.description: DropdownMenuContent: how it lines up with the trigger.

props.name: danger
props.description: DropdownMenuItem: a destructive action in color.status.danger.fg.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: DropdownMenuItem: closes the menu when chosen (false for checkbox and radio items by default).

props.name: disabled
props.description: On an item: shown in color.fg.disabled with aria-disabled; it cannot be chosen.

props.name: checked
props.description: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem: controlled state; onCheckedChange reports changes.

props.name: value
props.description: DropdownMenuRadioGroup: the chosen value (onValueChange); DropdownMenuRadioItem: its value.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal, at z.popover, with the trigger's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="dropdown-menu-positioner".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: role="menu", color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay, at most the viewport's free height; data-slot="dropdown-menu-content".

parts.name: DropdownMenuTrigger
parts.description: Opens the menu; unstyled, render a Button or IconButton. aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded.

parts.name: DropdownMenuContent
parts.description: The portal, the positioner and the menu.

parts.name: DropdownMenuItem
parts.description: role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.

parts.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
parts.description: role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.

parts.name: DropdownMenuRadioGroup
parts.description: role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.

parts.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
parts.description: role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.

parts.name: DropdownMenuLabel
parts.description: A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: DropdownMenuSeparator
parts.description: role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.

parts.name: DropdownMenuShortcut
parts.description: The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: DropdownMenuSubTrigger
parts.description: An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.

parts.name: DropdownMenuSubContent
parts.description: The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: the menu grows from 95 % at the trigger and fades in over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.enter; reduced motion turns it off.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The item under the pointer or the keyboard: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: submenu-open
states.description: A sub-trigger whose submenu is open keeps color.interactive.hover.

states.name: danger
states.description: A destructive item: color.status.danger.fg, color.status.danger.bg when highlighted.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A disabled item: color.fg.disabled and aria-disabled; reachable but not chosen.

accessibility: The trigger has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; the popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" (aria-checked) and "menuitemradio" items; groups are role="group" named by their label.

Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger opens the menu with the first item highlighted (ArrowUp: the last); arrow keys, Home and End move, typing jumps to an item, Enter or Space chooses, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.

ArrowRight (inline-end) on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable by the keyboard, as the ARIA menu pattern recommends, but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen.
A press outside closes the menu. A destructive item has danger and a clear label, so the meaning does not rest on colour; checked state shows a check mark or dot as well as aria-checked.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off.
The menu and its submenus take the trigger's theme and density, and sit at z.popover so a menu opened from a dialog is above it.
